description:
## Contact
Local-only message preview with responsive Bellini layouts and the shared Portfolio navigation. Required name (1–100), email (up to 254), and message (12–4000 characters) are checked by core fields and the preview handler, including trimmed whitespace checks. Button activation, Enter in single-line fields, and form submission share one guarded handler; textarea Enter retains newlines. Feedback is a persistent polite live region and edits invalidate the previous preview. No data is sent or persisted. **Production delivery is blocked until the user provides a backend/email service and end-to-end delivery is verified.** Existing /contact route and contact state are preserved; all Contact navigation uses confirmed sibling states.
